description: Authoritative server core: tick loop, ECS world, WebSocket gateway, persistence (slices 1.2+)
name: @mmo-engine/engine-core

scripts.build: node ../../scripts/dep-build.mjs @mmo-engine/schema && node ../../scripts/dep-build.mjs @mmo-engine/logging && node ../../scripts/dep-build.mjs @mmo-engine/mirror && node ../../scripts/dep-build.mjs @mmo-engine/modules && node ../../scripts/dep-build.mjs @mmo-engine/channel && node ../../scripts/dep-build.mjs @mmo-engine/protocol && node ../../scripts/dep-build.mjs @mmo-engine/art && node ../../scripts/dep-build.mjs @mmo-engine/world-server && node ../../scripts/dep-build.mjs @mmo-engine/scatter && node ../../scripts/dep-build.mjs @mmo-engine/picg && node ../../scripts/dep-build.mjs @mmo-engine/rules && node ../../scripts/dep-build.mjs @mmo-engine/scene && node ../../scripts/dep-build.mjs @mmo-engine/wfc && node ../../scripts/dep-build.mjs @mmo-engine/compose && node ../../scripts/dep-build.mjs @mmo-engine/placement && node ../../scripts/dep-build.mjs @mmo-engine/species && node ../../scripts/dep-build.mjs @mmo-engine/crafting && node ../../scripts/dep-build.mjs @mmo-engine/settlement && node ../../scripts/dep-build.mjs @mmo-engine/fortify && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run build && node --expose-gc --test --test-force-exit --test-skip-pattern="latency budget" "dist/test/**/*.test.js" && npm run test:perf
